Title: M-series VMs are now available in the South Africa North region

Body.Content:
Azure M-series VMs are now available in the US South Central region. M-series VMs offer configurations with memory from 192 GB to 3.8TiB (4TB) RAM and are certified for SAP HANA. For more information on M-series availability by regions and for upcoming region launches, please visit the Azure regions page here. 

Learn more about running SAP workloads on Azure
